protocol.evaluation: Offline visual-goal planning; predictions were not executed on the robot.
protocol.reference: Recorded onboard odometry in meters; approximate visual camera alignment.
protocol.selection: Thirty clips from seven newer recordings were selected and frozen for scene diversity, camera visibility and complete pose coverage before inference, without filtering by model metrics. Eight historical performance-curated clips are retained. Seven additional quality-approved historical clips were restored for scene/time coverage and available delivery capacity, without using model scores. These seven use existing evaluated results; they were not selected before inference. Every displayed video shows constant arithmetic mean ATE/RPE over all complete local plans within that clip.
protocol.planning: Each local plan starts from recorded context; both models share goals, horizon and CEM budget within each clip.
protocol.metrics: Paper ATE/RPE definitions, averaged across complete local plans. Different planning horizons are reported separately.
protocol.sampling: Original DDPM checkpoints; no DMD2. Budget and exact settings are retained per clip.

visualization.navigation_metrics: Constant arithmetic mean of all complete local plans within this clip, in meters.
visualization.third_person: Dominant full-aspect video; high-quality SDR conversion where required.
visualization.gt_ego: High-resolution recorded frames with the same center crop as model input, shown at matched 4 Hz timestamps.
visualization.model: Exact saved generated frames, repeated at output FPS; no image enhancement or replacement.
visualization.sampling: Nearest 4 Hz sample shared by GT/model/trajectory; third-person follows aligned continuous time.
visualization.trajectory: Forward up, physical left to the left. Equal metric scale shared by all three paths, fit per local plan; no smoothing.

quality.review_scope: The 30 newer clips were reviewed at 2 Hz, plus ego/third-person alignment anchors. The seven restored historical clips belong to the quality-approved archive reviewed at 4 Hz. Their fixed mean panels are regenerated from original evaluator results; model/source views are retained.
quality.audio: No audio streams in rendered or published videos.
quality.source_retention: Original archives, source videos and full-resolution masters retained on NAS.
